nodes.name: Every Morning 07:00
nodes.notes: Daily cadence for the executive report. Cadence is driven by the schedule, not by a weekday check.

parameters.query:
SELECT id, customer_id, channel, category, intent, sentiment, urgency,
       ai_confidence, escalation_status, resolution_status, response_time_ms, created_at
FROM conversations
WHERE created_at >= ((date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE $1) - INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE $1)
  AND created_at <  (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE $1) AT TIME ZONE $1)
ORDER BY created_at ASC;
